units.title: Surface ornamentation through Embroidery
topics: 1.1.1. Basic stitches: back stitch, stem stitch, blanket stitch, chain stitch, feather stitch, herring bone stitch, cross stitch, bullion stitch, French knot, satin stitch, long and short stitch, laid and couching stitch.
1.1.2. Fancy embroidery stitches: Creative Surface Ornamentation Course Code: 4355107 mirror work, bead work, zardosi work, applique work, patch work.
uos: 1.b. Prepare garments using basic embroidery stitches.
1.c. Design garments using fancy embroidery stitches.

units.title: Surface ornamentation through Printing and painting
topics: 2.2. Block printing using wooden block or vegetable blocks.

units.title: Surface ornamentation of printed fabric
